one_line: A school-readiness line first, then a child practising each classroom task with the real equipment from above.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a child's hand draws coloured shapes on a sheet, Giotto and Lyra boxes along the left edge. Voiceover (transcript): "חלק ממוכנות לכיתה א' זה לתרגל את הדברים הקטנים". Faint word-by-word text from 0:01, a full block by 0:03.
q1_hook.why: A real seasonal parent question is stated in the first sentence, with a child practising and the boxes in frame (K6, K7, S1). Voice and words arrive together (H6), but the text is faint at 0:01 (T3, T5), it opens with a statement, not a problem or result (H1), and no face (H4).

beats.what: A child draws shapes, then writes letters with a pink pencil; "חלק ממוכנות לכיתה א' זה לתרגל"
beats.why: The topic and the practice in one image.

beats.what: An adult hand holds a pink pencil; "להכיר את הציוד שלהם ולדעת איפה מונח כל דבר"
beats.why: Names the first skill, knowing your equipment.

beats.what: A child takes markers and a pencil from a pink pencil case; "כולם מוציאים עיפרון", "מחק", "צבע אדום"
A child rules lines with a pencil and a metal ruler; "אנחנו התחלנו לתרגל כבר בבית"
A hand fans pencils with finger dimples; orange text: "הם כמובן של חברת גיאוטו"
beats.why: The brand credit and the grip claim.

beats.what: A child lines up markers in a rainbow row beside the boxes; "עכשיו תורכם"
Flat lay of Giotto and Lyra boxes; scattered letters of "תתאמנו בבית על מגוון פעולות"; "בהצלחה 🤍"
beats.why: The invitation to try it at home.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: a hashtag question, "#מהי מוכנות עבורך?". The voice at 0:43 says "עכשיו תורכם תתאמנו בבית", a call to practise, not to comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: Each classroom task is a new picture every 5 to 10 s, a child acts it out and the voice explains it (R3, F8). The pencil fan at 0:34 to 0:43 is a long product stretch with no new action (R3). It ends on a flat lay with no payoff for the child (R4), and 54 s is long (R2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript, 0:43 to 0:48): "עכשיו תורכם תתאמנו בבית על מגוון פעולות"; subtitled with the words scattered across the frame. Caption: "מוכנות מילה אחת ואין סוף אפשרויות#מהי מוכנות עבורך?". No link, code or comment word.
q3_cta.why: The ask is to try the practice at home, a purpose-driven invitation (C2) and one action (C1), but nothing measurable: no keyword, link or send (C3, C4). The caption question is welded to a hashtag, so it does not read as a question (C5).

q4_shown.what: Giotto and Lyra boxes in frame from 0:00; a child drawing, writing, taking items from a pink pencil case, ruling, lining up markers; an adult hand with a pink pencil and pencil fan; a flat lay. A LYRA box held 0:34 to 0:42. No price.
q4_shown.why: The equipment is in use from 0:00, in a real classroom routine (S1, K5, F8), with a first-person line, "אנחנו התחלנו לתרגל" (S6). The spoken credit to Giotto plays over Lyra-branded packs, so the brand message is unclear (H3, C7). A child's hands and partly a face are shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 53.8 s, 6 s average, straight cuts at 1.4, 2.6, 8.9, 16.1, 26.8, 33.7, 43.0 and 47.9 s, static and handheld top-down. Voiceover nearly wall to wall; word-by-word subtitles build blocks of up to six lines. Ends on a flat lay.
q5_edit.why: Cuts to a new task every 5 to 10 s keep a long Reel moving (E2, R3). The voice carries the message and subtitles build in step (E4, T1), but as long blocks over busy pictures (T2). It ends right after the sign-off (E8), yet 54 s is long (R2).

q6_topic.what: Practising small classroom tasks at home before first grade (taking out equipment, ruling, ordering), with the pencils and markers used. Serves a parent preparing a child for school.
q6_topic.why: School readiness is a dated, shared parent concern and a buying moment for stationery (K6, K7). The advice is concrete, delivered through a child at work, and modest (K4). There is no peak emotion (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone shots from above at a wooden table in daylight: handheld on the child's hands, static on the ruler task and flat lay, an adult hand holding pencils up close. A child's torso 0:16 to 0:47, her face partly seen at 0:22.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands on the table are the first-choice view (F5, S4), with readable pages and packs (F4). Daylight and a homely table look native (H8, F7). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3). A child's face appears briefly, which LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white subtitles, centred at about 35 to 55% down, building word by word into blocks of up to six lines: "חלק ממוכנות לכיתה א' זה לתרגל את הדברים הקטנים" (0:01), "כולם מוציאים עיפרון" (0:16), "אנחנו התחלנו לתרגל כבר בבית" (0:23). Orange text "כל הציוד האיכותי שאתן רואות בסרטון הם כמובן של חברת גיאוטו" (0:33). At 0:47 the letters scatter. "בהצלחה 🤍" at the bottom (0:52).
q8_text.caption: "מוכנות מילה אחת ואין סוף אפשרויות". About 11 words: the line runs into a hashtag "#מהי מוכנות עבורך?", then the tag @giotto_israel. No ask, no keywords beyond "מוכנות", no partnership word.
q8_text.why: The subtitles read muted (T1) but fill the middle of busy pictures in small text, long blocks and low contrast on the white paper (T2, T5). The scattered letters at 0:47 are broken (T6). The caption is one line with no keywords, hashtags or disclosure (T7, S7, T8).

weak_points: The Giotto credit is spoken over Lyra packs; long, small, low-contrast subtitle blocks over busy pictures; scattered letters at 0:47; no real CTA; the caption question inside a hashtag; 54 s; a child's face and torso.
lumebook_takeaway: Start with the seasonal parent line over a top-down shot, show each practice task with hands only, and end with one question as a normal caption line.
not_verified: Whether the pencils held at 0:34 are Giotto's (the box reads LYRA); whether the partnership was paid (co-author listed, no label, a tag in the caption); the creator's profession; music (none evident). Corrections to the first pass: no text in the first frame (it fades in from 0:01); the Lyra box is held, not behind, at 0:34 to 0:42; the subtitles sit mid-frame, not low. Plays 6,004, likes 32, comments 9 on 15 Oct are context only. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
